# PULL REQUEST

## Purpose and Content
Applying flux correction only deteriorates qtot profile because of the discontinuities in its initial profile. When Flux correction is not applied the advection scheme captures the profile at the discontinuities better. But this will cause extra fluctuations in the profile. In the case of qtot these fluctuations are negligible. However, for other components such as liquid and rain applying flux correction is necessary as the effect flux correction seems to be small and without flux correction strong fluctuations can appear in the solutions. In this PR I make the option for enabling flux correction only effective on qtot.
title: make flux correction choice an option only for qtot
